title: Fallout 3 — FOS Body / Change-State Format Evidence Gate v3.2b
question: Can a Fallout 3 .fos body region be located and decoded into structured quest/reference runtime state using FO3-applicable primary implementation evidence, without importing unsupported body layouts from Fallout New Vegas, Skyrim or Fallout 4?

establishes: header metadata, screenshot and ordered plugin-list parsing

wrye_bash.module_scope_statement: The source module explicitly describes itself as headers code only and leaves per-game save classes/body handling as TODO.
fo3_specific_findings: Fallout3SaveHeader sets the inherited master/version marker to 0x15.
The inherited master-list-size routine reads a byte plus uint32 and validates the byte against the game-specific marker.
wrye_bash.location_table_clue: The same source module contains header-rewrite infrastructure describing a file-location table with named offsets including formIdArrayCount, global-data tables and changeFormsOffset.

why_not_promote_yet: A symbol or comment named changeFormsOffset is format knowledge, not by itself proof that a particular FO3 save uses that exact table layout at the expected post-master position.
Fallout3SaveHeader inheritance from FalloutNVSaveHeader creates a strong implementation lead but neighboring-game inheritance is exactly where silent layout transfer can occur.
Neither reviewed implementation currently supplies semantic decoding of an MQDadRef, MQ04, MQ04Doc or pod/shell runtime record from a Fallout 3 body.
No real T0/T1/T2/T3 .fos inputs are presently available in the user file library to execute structural boundary checks.

admission_ladder.name: HEADER_AUTHENTICATED
admission_ladder.requirement: v3.2a parses FO3 header/plugin environment and freezes file SHA-256.

admission_ladder.name: FO3_LOCATION_TABLE_APPLICABILITY
admission_ladder.requirement: Trace Wrye Bash method resolution or another primary implementation/spec to prove that the named location-table path applies to Fallout3SaveHeader, not merely another supported game.

admission_ladder.name: REAL_SAVE_OFFSET_SANITY
admission_ladder.requirement: On at least one authenticated FO3 .fos, parse the candidate location table and verify offsets are in-file, ordered/region-compatible where expected, and stable under a no-op save control.

admission_ladder.name: CHANGE_REGION_STRUCTURAL_RECORDS
admission_ladder.requirement: Identify record boundaries, IDs/types/lengths or an equivalent structured grammar inside the candidate change region from primary implementation/spec evidence or controlled differential reconstruction.

admission_ladder.name: JAMES_ANCHOR_BINDING
admission_ladder.requirement: Bind at least one structured body record to MQDadRef, MQ04, MQ04DocRef, MQ04DadPod or MQ04DadPodShellRef without using raw four-byte FormID coincidence alone.

admission_ladder.name: T0_T3_LIFECYCLE
admission_ladder.requirement: Replay the bound structured record across T0/T1/T2/T3 and classify creation, mutation, persistence or disappearance through the TL exit boundary.

admission_ladder.name: PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS
admission_ladder.requirement: Independently demonstrate that a surviving James-specific record carries memory/autobiographical payload semantics rather than quest/reference metadata.

planned_controls.same_lineage_no_op_pair: Two saves taken with minimal/no gameplay state change to estimate incidental body churn and offset relocation.
planned_controls.unrelated_quest_control: Track an unrelated quest/reference with known runtime changes to validate that the decoder can detect ordinary engine persistence.
planned_controls.player_container_control: MQ04PlayerContainerRef remains a positive runtime-state/negative James-memory control.
planned_controls.raw_formid_collision_control: Search randomized and unrelated FormIDs in the same body to estimate how often four-byte patterns occur without structured reference meaning.
planned_controls.plugin_environment_control: v3.2a must pass identical ordered plugin manifests before T0-T3 semantic comparison.

first_break_model.chain: AUTHENTIC_FO3_SAVE -> FO3_LOCATION_TABLE -> CHANGE_REGION -> STRUCTURED_RECORD -> JAMES_BINDING -> CROSS_EXIT_PERSISTENCE -> PAYLOAD_SEMANTICS -> IN_WORLD_SERIALIZATION
first_break_model.meaning: The research has moved beyond raw archive/ESM topology and now has a bounded path to runtime state, but no body-level James claim has passed.

next_actions: Trace the exact Wrye Bash method-resolution/write-header path for Fallout3SaveHeader and determine whether six named location-table offsets are inherited unchanged.
Search additional primary open-source FO3 save implementations for independent agreement on the location table and change-record grammar.
When real T0-T3 .fos inputs are supplied, run v3.2a first and freeze their plugin environment before any body parsing.
Implement only the smallest proven next parser: location-table extraction before record semantics.
